shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '*config*' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'README*'"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat src/index.css && cat vite.config.ts && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/uikit @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -55 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts && cat index.html && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -15 && rg --files node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer' | head"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | rg '(TextInput.*d.ts|Checkbox.*d.ts|Provider.*d.ts|INDEX.md|Button.*d.ts)"'$'"' | head -35; cat index.html; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -12; rg --files node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer' | head"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/Provider.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | rg '/(TextInput|Checkbox|Button)/.*d.ts"'$'"' | head -20; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -85; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/{Eye,EyeSlash,ArrowRight,Lock,ShieldCheck,CircleQuestion,ArrowUpRight,Check}.js"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts | head -180; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -90'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '82,89p'; cat tsconfig.json; ls /tmp; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/App.tsx')
s = p.read_text().replace('private browsing. */}} >', 'private browsing. */}}} >')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright --version'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm config get cache; git diff --stat; cat .gitignore; npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css index.html'
/bin/bash -lc "find /home/node/.npm/_npx -path '*/playwright/package.json' -print"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright install-deps chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check && git status --short'
